title: Diamond Elite Card: Premium Credit Limits and Account Management
summary: This document describes the Diamond Elite Card credit limit range ($37,500–$375,000), how limits are initially assigned, and payment expectations (minimum 3.0% of statement balance or statement minimum, $32.50 late fee, 15.99% interest on carried balances). It also covers procedures for temporary limit reviews, real-time credit alerts, and steps to request permanent limit increases using on-time payments, low utilization, and current income documentation.
